equivalent_mutants.reason: This mutation changes only the zero-return continuation of index 0x441030 (original 0x441080..0x4410a4). Before that continuation, original grow 0x4db6e0 sets EBP=0 on a null realloc result and calls 0x4dc680, which faults reading address 4. The unchanged native core grow likewise calls diagnostic with EBP=0 and faults before returning. Success returns a nonzero pointer and bypasses this block. Therefore no permitted returning or faulting input can execute the mutated statement; both prefixes are unchanged. This is the same original-proven range recorded in coverage_exempt, not equivalence inferred from surviving tests.

notes: Group 3 adapts exactly the eleven owned original entries using the unchanged canonical registry core and existing typed binding descriptors. Registration callback addresses remain data and confer no actor-body ownership. Coverage exemptions cover only returning fallback blocks unreachable after the original grow helper faults at address 4 on allocation failure.
